en_title: Sony Just Announced a $6,000 Gold-Plated Walkman
cn_title: 索尼公布镀金音乐播放器
subtitle: 不只是为了好看
opus_summary: 索尼公布镀金音乐播放器NW-WM1ZM3，现已开放预购，将于1月上市。索尼称，镀金无氧铜机身有助提升音质；该机配备5.5英寸屏幕，续航可达35小时。

paragraphs.en: Have you ever looked at your phone and thought, "This should only play music, and it should be shinier?" Well, good news, Sony is bringing out a $5,899 Walkman, and it's gold plated. The NW-WM1ZM3 model will be available in January, but preorders are available now.
paragraphs.cn: 你有没有看着手机，心想：「这东西应该只能播放音乐，而且还得更闪亮一点？」好消息来了，索尼即将推出一款售价5,899美元(约合人民币4万元)的Walkman，而且还是镀金的。这款型号为NW-WM1ZM3的播放器将于1月上市，目前已开放预购。

paragraphs.en: According to Sony, the gold isn't just there for show. According to the official announcement:
paragraphs.cn: 索尼表示，镀金不只是为了好看。官方公告写道：

paragraphs.en: "The NW-WM1ZM3 is built around a precision-machined, gold-plated oxygen-free copper (OFC) chassis, engineered specifically to further elevate the sound quality of this flagship model. It features a 99.99% (4N) purity OFC main chassis and an OFC rear chassis. These are secured with screws featuring a low-resistance gold-plated treatment applied exclusively for this model, providing a stable ground connection that delivers powerful bass, an expansive soundstage, and smooth, extended high frequencies."
paragraphs.cn: 「NW-WM1ZM3采用精密加工的镀金无氧铜（OFC）机身，专为进一步提升这款旗舰机型的音质而设计。其主机身采用纯度为99.99%（4N）的无氧铜，背部机身也采用无氧铜。两者通过螺丝固定，螺丝采用本机型专属的低电阻镀金处理，确保接地连接稳定，从而带来强劲的低音、开阔的声场，以及顺滑且延展出色的高频表现。」

paragraphs.en: It also has 35 hours of battery life, a 5.5-inch screen, and uses Sony's DSD Remastering Engine for better sound quality.
paragraphs.cn: 这款播放器还拥有35小时续航，配备5.5英寸屏幕，并采用索尼的DSD重制引擎（DSD Remastering Engine）来提升音质。

paragraphs.en: This isn't Sony's first gold-plated Walkman; it released the NW-WM1ZM2 for $3,200 back in 2022. Those now go for around $1,500 on eBay, if you're looking for a bargain.
paragraphs.cn: 这并不是索尼首款镀金Walkman；早在2022年，索尼就推出了售价3,200美元(约合人民币2万元)的NW-WM1ZM2。如果你想淘个便宜货，这款旧机型目前在eBay上的价格约为1,500美元(约合人民币1万元)。
